spec: During release sync, validate can count an engine-created zzzops/sync/g<ID>/integration branch as pre-reset state. Recognize documented current operation-owned ref shapes in legacy detection while retaining detection of genuinely old or unknown refs. Verify actual release-operation namespaces against their producers and add focused deterministic coverage for a genuine legacy ref alongside a current sync ref. Do not broadly ignore unknown zzzops refs.
title: Exclude current release-operation refs from legacy detection
